    // The relative standard uncertainty of a parameter: its standard
    // uncertainty as a fraction of its nominal value. Precondition: the
    // nominal value is non-zero.
    RelativeUncertainty(self: CalibrationParameter): Number
        => self.Value.StandardUncertainty / self.Value.Value.Abs;
